name: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys
description:
Renders PolyhedraPhys objects as cylinders of which diameter and color depends on PolyhedraPhys::normForce magnitude.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.maxFn(=0)

	Value of NormPhys.normalForce corresponding to maxDiameter<Gl1_NormPhys.maxDiameter>. This value will be increased (but *not decreased* ) automatically.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.refRadius(=std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity())

	Reference (minimum) particle radius

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.signFilter(=0)

	If non-zero, only display contacts with negative (-1) or positive (+1) normal forces; if zero, all contacts will be displayed.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.maxRadius(=-1)

	Cylinder radius corresponding to the maximum normal force.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.slices(=6)

	Number of sphere slices; (see `glutCylinder reference <http://www.opengl.org/sdk/docs/man/xhtml/gluCylinder.xml>`__)

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_PolyhedraPhys.stacks(=1)

	Number of sphere stacks; (see `glutCylinder reference <http://www.opengl.org/sdk/docs/man/xhtml/gluCylinder.xml>`__)
